narratives.title: Platform Adoption Q3 2026
narratives.body: Q3 focused on establishing the SCALE measurement framework and baselining platform adoption metrics. Key achievements: (1) mogo remains the most widely adopted library at 29% penetration across 696 repos, (2) omniagent framework reached production readiness with 2 dependent projects, (3) VisionStudio dashboard now tracks 25 repositories across initiatives. Dependency hygiene is strong: 92% of repos have no replace directives and 98% have matching module names.

narratives.title: Platform Adoption Q4 Goals
narratives.body: Q4 priorities: (1) Increase omniagent adoption from 2 to 5+ projects by improving onboarding docs and starter templates, (2) Integrate gitscan into CI for automated dependency ordering, (3) Expand SCALE assessments to cover api and observability domains, (4) Target 35% mogo adoption by promoting to plexusone repos not yet adopting.
